identificationModule.briefTitle: S1216, Phase III ADT+TAK-700 vs. ADT+Bicalutamide for Metastatic Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Randomized Trial Comparing Androgen Deprivation Therapy + TAK-700 With Androgen Deprivation Therapy + Bicalutamide in Patients With Newly Diagnosed Metastatic Sensitive Prostate Cancer

armGroups.label: ADT + TAK-700
armGroups.description:
LHRH agonist - given as approved for androgen deprivation at a dose necessary to maintain castrate levels and equivalent to 22.5 mg of Leuprolide IM every 3 months.

TAK-700, 300 mg, PO, twice daily

armGroups.label: ADT + Bicalutamide
armGroups.description:
LHRH agonist - given as approved for androgen deprivation at a dose necessary to maintain castrate levels and equivalent to 22.5 mg of Leuprolide IM every 3 months.

Bicalutamide, 50 mg, PO, q daily
